source.label: Smithsonian National Zoo ZooLights news release (October 8, 2026)

image.alt: Family event · Washington, DC. Smithsonian ZooLights: USD 10 tickets, free for kids 2 and under. Checked on the official page October 28, 2026.

threads.text:
Smithsonian ZooLights: USD 10 tickets, free for kids 2 and under

When: Select evenings from November 20, 2026 to January 3, 2027: Nov 20-22, Nov 27-29, Dec 4-6, Dec 11-13, Dec 18-23, Dec 26-30 and Jan 2-3 (December 16 is adults-only).

Cost: USD 10 per person; everyone age 3 and older needs a ticket and children 2 and younger are free.

Indoor animal exhibits are closed on ZooLights nights, and the zoo closes to everyone at 4 p.m. and reopens at 5 p.m. for ticket holders.

facebook.text:
Smithsonian ZooLights: USD 10 tickets, free for kids 2 and under

When: Select evenings from November 20, 2026 to January 3, 2027: Nov 20-22, Nov 27-29, Dec 4-6, Dec 11-13, Dec 18-23, Dec 26-30 and Jan 2-3 (December 16 is adults-only). Monday to Saturday 5-9 p.m. (last entry 8:30 p.m.), Sunday 5-8 p.m. (last entry 7:30 p.m.), rain or shine.

Cost: USD 10 per person; everyone age 3 and older needs a ticket and children 2 and younger are free. Event parking is USD 30 per vehicle in advance or USD 40 on the day, subject to availability.

Booking: Tickets can be bought online in advance, and the zoo encourages buying early because capacity is limited. December 8 and 9 are Member Nights, with free entry tickets reserved in advance by zoo members.

Family note: Indoor animal exhibits are closed on ZooLights nights, and the zoo closes to everyone at 4 p.m. and reopens at 5 p.m. for ticket holders. Woodley Park-Zoo and Cleveland Park Metro stations are within walking distance.
